---
name: Feature request
description: Suggest a new capability or improvement for LinkRouter
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: [enhancement]
assignees: []
---

**Before you file**

- [ ] I searched the [issues](https://github.com/aLordCo/link-router/issues) to make sure this hasn't been requested before.

## Problem statement

What are you trying to do, and why is the current app not good enough for it?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or behavior you'd like. Be specific about how it should work.

## Alternative approaches

What else could work (even partially) and why you chose this one.

## Scope

- [ ] Routing / rules
- [ ] Browser / profile detection
- [ ] Prompter UI
- [ ] Settings / config
- [ ] System integration (default browser, tray, deep links)
- [ ] Platform-specific (Linux / macOS / Windows)
- [ ] Other

## Additional context

Links, mockups, screenshots, or anything else that helps understand the request.
